data.narrative:
FlyBy Robotics is a Seed-stage defense and security robotics company that has raised $5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public companies operating in the Defense & Security sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI across Seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $5M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $12M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yielding a median valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods yields a valuation range of $11M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $206M. The substantial spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation and peer comparability. Key drivers of this variance include the wide dispersion in Defense & Security peer valuations and ambiguity regarding FlyBy's market traction relative to named comparables. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor, while peer medians suggest higher potential if FlyBy's competitive positioning aligns with top-tier peers. Additional clarity on revenue, customer traction, and technical differentiation would narrow this range materially.
